nodes.title: SG-1.4 · Compact header overlay wired to the UI store with Tailwind layout tests
nodes.body:
Context: GameLayout is already Tailwind-based and useUiStore holds soundEnabled and settingsOpen, but App renders a bare RoundBadge and Countdown inside the scene and shows 'Round unavailable' when the API fails, with no explanation. Desired behavior: a compact header overlay shows logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings, wired to useUiStore, with loading and error states. Expected result: header is visible over the scene and tests/layout.test.tsx asserts Tailwind classes instead of legacy CSS strings. Why: the goal requires a polished header and honest round-status feedback.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a loaded round, when the header renders, then logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings are visible
- Given the round request is pending or failed, when the header renders, then a loading or an explained error message is shown instead of 'Round unavailable'
- Given the sound toggle or settings button is clicked, when the store is read, then soundEnabled or settingsOpen has flipped
- Given tests/layout.test.tsx runs, when it asserts layout, then it checks Tailwind classes and not legacy CSS strings


## Scope
- In scope: HeaderOverlay component
- In scope: App round loading/error state and header wiring
- In scope: GameLayout header slot
- In scope: tests/layout.test.tsx update
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Phaser integration
- Out of scope: Settings dialog contents
- Out of scope: Audio playback
- Preserve: RoundBadge and Countdown public behavior and their tests
- Preserve: Existing uiStore API
- Preserve: ContributionSheet flow


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript, Tailwind, Lucide icons, Zustand
- Use real getCurrentRound API, no mock data in product code


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered with passing unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- Header must not cause horizontal overflow on mobile


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · HeaderOverlay shows logo, world, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings from the UI store
nodes.body:
Context: no HeaderOverlay exists. Desired behavior: a presentational component taking worldTitle, round (loading|error|ready) and rendering the six elements, with sound and settings buttons bound to useUiStore. Expected result: compact top overlay with accessible buttons. Why: header requirement of the redesign.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a ready round, when rendered, then StoryForge, world title, round id, status badge and a timer are shown
- Given loading state, when rendered, then text 'Loading round…' is shown and no timer
- Given error state with a message, when rendered, then the message is shown and 'Round unavailable' alone is not
- Given clicks on the Sound and Settings buttons, when the store is read, then soundEnabled and settingsOpen are toggled and aria-pressed reflects state


## Scope
- In scope: src/components/HeaderOverlay.tsx
- Out of scope: Fetching the round
- Preserve: Countdown
- Preserve: RoundBadge


## Technical constraints
- Reuse Countdown and RoundBadge; Lucide Volume2/VolumeX/Settings icons; Button from ./ui/button


## Definition of done
- Component exported and type-checks


## Non-functional requirements
- Buttons have aria-labels


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · App loads the current round with loading and error state and passes it to the header
nodes.body:
Context: App swallows getCurrentRound errors and shows 'Round unavailable'. Desired behavior: App tracks loading/error, builds an error message from the failure, and renders HeaderOverlay via GameLayout's header slot instead of loose RoundBadge/Countdown. Why: no unexplained failures.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given getCurrentRound resolves, when App is playing, then header shows round id and status
- Given getCurrentRound rejects, when App is playing, then header shows an alert containing 'Round status unavailable' and the failure reason
- Given getCurrentRound is pending, when App is playing, then 'Loading round…' is shown

- Out of scope: API client changes
- Preserve: Suggest What Happens Next button and ContributionSheet
- Preserve: Intro gate

- Keep getCurrentRound from ./api/client

nodes.title: REQ · GameLayout hosts the header overlay and layout tests assert Tailwind classes
nodes.body:

Desired behavior: GameLayout renders an optional header prop absolutely over main, and layout.test.tsx asserts Tailwind classes on root, main and aside plus header placement.
